description: Use when an agent needs US spot bitcoin or ether ETF holdings from official filings (IBIT, FBTC, GBTC, ETHA...). Input: asset (btc or eth), optional ticker. Output: JSON per fund coins held (reported or estimated), fair value USD, NAV/share, shares outstanding, sponsor fee, period end, change vs previous period, share of coins, filing link; totals. From 10-Q/10-K XBRL, not daily flows. Cached 12 h. Example: ?asset=btc Price: $0.0045 USDC (Base or Solana) via x402.

asset.description: btc (11 spot bitcoin ETFs) or eth (8 spot ether ETFs)

ticker.description: One fund only (IBIT, FBTC, GBTC, BTC, ARKB, BITB, HODL, BRRR, EZBC, BTCO, BTCW; ETHA, FETH, ETHE, ETH, ETHW, EZET, QETH, TETH). Unknown: 400 before payment
